capabilities: pull pending notes from a Moltn install into a chosen vault folder on a timer and at startup
acknowledge received notes so Moltn deletes them from its outbox
add a numeric suffix instead of overwriting on name clashes
push a chosen folder to Moltn as citable context
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not sync the vault between devices; notes travel between devices only via your own sync service afterward.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; sideloaded by copying manifest.json, main.js and styles.css into the plugins folder. Full architecture docs live outside the README.
problem: Notes produced in Moltn (dictations, meeting notes) need a way to land in an Obsidian vault without manual copying.

relations.evidence: Pulls finished notes from your Moltn install into this vault

requires.name: vault token from Moltn admin settings

summary: Integration that pulls finished notes from a Moltn install into a vault folder and can push a chosen folder back to Moltn as context.
